referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process represents the operation of a lorry for one hour in Switzerland and includes diesel combustion and the associated building machine demand as subprocesses. Specific diesel demand, service life time, operation weight and annual operating hours have been taken into account. Waste disposal processes are not included in the scope of this dataset.
